summary.text: Juan Garcia is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 13-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Tom Dent (R).
Ballotpedia lists him as a correctional officer.

paragraphs.text: Juan Garcia's Ballotpedia profile lists his career experience as working as a correctional officer.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he goes by Jerry, is a corrections officer from Othello, Washington, and was born and raised in the area, with past work in agricultural fields, factories, retail and landlording.
Garcia advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 30.3 percent of the vote, behind Dent, who received 69.5 percent.
In the survey, he said he will accept no corporate PAC money and listed affordability, universal healthcare, rent control amendments and public investment among his key messages.
